experiment.title: SCE Experiment 2.5 - Detective Probe: IMDS Weakening and Credential Access Detectability
experiment.description: Validates that the detective controls for SCE node 2.5 fire correctly when attack nodes 1.2 (ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions setting HttpTokens=optional and HopLimit=2, downgrading IMDSv2 to IMDSv1 and enabling container bridge traversal to 169.254.169.254 without a session token) and 2.2 (ec2:DescribeInstances confirmation that the weakened IMDS state persists in the EC2 control plane, verifying the attacker precondition for unauthenticated credential retrieval) are executed against a scoped EC2 instance in a clean AWS account. This revision fixes the root cause of three consecutive failed executions: Run 1 (CFN ROLLBACK_COMPLETE, no event introspection), Run 2 (CFN CREATE_FAILED due to missing iam:CreateRole, fixed by moving IAM outside CFN), and Run 3 (IAM ValidationError on the role Description field containing non-ASCII Unicode characters - fixed by removing all Description= parameters from IAM API calls and sanitizing all string values via _sanitize_aws_string() and _safe_role_name()). All IAM roles and instance profiles are created directly via boto3 before CloudFormation is invoked. The CFN stack contains only networking resources (VPC, Subnet, IGW, RouteTable, SecurityGroup), a CloudWatch Log Group, a VPC Flow Log referencing the pre-created IAM role ARN, and the EC2 target instance. GuardDuty is managed outside CloudFormation. The AMI is resolved at runtime via boto3. The probe confirms three independent detective signals within a 30-minute SLA: (A) GuardDuty raises Policy:EC2/NoIMDSv2 or a related finding after the IMDS downgrade (ADT node 2.3), (B) the VPC Flow Log delivery pipeline has active log streams in the CloudWatch Log Group (ADT node 2.3), and (C) the EC2 control plane durably reflects the weakened IMDS configuration as a CloudTrail proxy signal (ADT node 1.3). The attack timestamp filter uses a 60-second buffer to tolerate minor clock skew. Rollback deletes the CFN stack, all boto3-created IAM resources, and the GuardDuty detector only if this experiment created it.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Detective controls are active and all three signals fire within 30-minute SLA after IMDS weakening

probes.name: Verify GuardDuty Policy:EC2/NoIMDSv2 finding, VPC Flow Log delivery pipeline activity, and EC2 control-plane IMDS state persistence all confirmed within 30-minute SLA after attack nodes 1.2 and 2.2

method.name: Create IAM roles and instance profile via boto3 (no Description field to avoid ValidationError); resolve AMI at runtime via SSM public parameter; deploy CloudFormation stack with networking and EC2 only; get-or-create GuardDuty detector; wait for EC2 running; assert IMDSv2 baseline HttpTokens=required HopLimit=1

rollbacks.name: Delete CloudFormation stack; delete boto3-created IAM roles and instance profile; delete GuardDuty detector only if created by this experiment; tolerant of missing resources and pre-existing conditions
